mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS decline in the prior 20 days is followed by negative 20-day forward returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals labor market deterioration, which may precede a recession and cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.0% is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production and residential investment indicate a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and RSAFS both decline >0.5% from prior month
failure_condition: In >60% of instances where INDPRO and RSAFS both decline >0.5% from prior month, the 20-day forward return is positive, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a decline in the unemployment rate signals an exceptionally strong labor market that may prompt further aggressive rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, a UNRATE decline >0.3% from prior month is followed by positive 20-day returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts indicate robust consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST increase >0.5% from prior month is followed by negative 60-day forward returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year inflation rate above 3.0% signals potential for aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in residential investment signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rise >0.2% and RSAFS decline >0.5% from prior month
regime_hint: labor market and consumer spending deterioration
failure_condition: In >60% of instances where UNRATE rises >0.2% and RSAFS declines >0.5% from prior month, the 20-day forward return is positive, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production indicates strong economic activity and corporate profitability, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO increase >0.5% from prior month is followed by negative 5-day forward returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
